reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Conditional mathematical self-review only, including a refuted objective implication. No correspondence/calibration, originality, native interface, experiment or method verdict verified.

formal_object.rationale: Separate centered squared pointwise population risk from fixed-design smoothed unsquared development risk. Neither is declared the official native mesh metric.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: E03 and D05 expansions retain their original conditions. Tangent majorization adds explicit tau>0, lambda>0, positive total weight, qualified labels/features and unconstrained affine-solve conditions; all science conditions remain unobserved.

derivation.rationale: Exact four-atom arithmetic gives squared 10 -> 45/17 and unsquared 1 -> 27/17. The square-root tangent inequality, gradient Theta H-K, Gram positive definiteness, MM sandwich and tau-smoothing bound are derived separately. Forty finite descent checks illustrate the formula without replacing proof. No ICP operator is silently folded into a 4x4 plain-coordinate solve.

assumptions.rationale: Development GT tracking does not establish decoded-vertex material labels. Legal mapping/lift, alignment, family-separated calibration and transfer remain blockers. Data-calibrated coefficients are not claimed zero-shot. Zero ordinary cross-covariance is not a sufficient unsquared stationarity condition.

method_expression.rationale: Both squared and smoothed-unsquared affine estimators stay within C03; the intercept absorbs mean correction once. Exact common anchor override is preserved. MM/ridge/smoothing variants are not extra pool entries; native implementation is pending.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Compare native scores of squared/unsquared fits under identical legal labels, features and costs. Loss descent is not an efficacy prediction by itself. Matched simpler unsquared estimators may refute matrix necessity; unqualified mapping or insufficient precision yields inconclusive.

closest_alternative.rationale: Classical matrix control variates, robust affine regression, IRLS/MM, the historical correlated prototype and C01 are named. Reading notes attribute classical MM and state limited reading scope; originality and functional-collision review remain open.
